# beads v1.0.0 CLI contract sample

Captured using repo-local mise pin:

```bash
mise x github:gastownhall/beads@1.0.0 -- bd version
```

Observed output:

```text
bd version 1.0.0 (72170267: HEAD@72170267e00a)
```

The `beads_v1_show_issue.json` golden in this directory is a representative
`bd show <id> --json` payload shape from the same v1 contract documented in
`docs/BEADS-V1-SPEC.md`.
